content: Research conducted by the American Diabetes Association (ADA) on the role of carbohydrates in diabetes management has not provided definitive conclusions regarding the ideal carbohydrate intake for individuals with diabetes. However, careful monitoring of carbohydrate consumption is recognized as a fundamental approach to achieving effective glucose control in both type 1 and type 2 diabetes. Evidence from studies suggests that adopting low-carbohydrate or very-low-carbohydrate diets can lead to reductions in A1C levels. Additionally, these dietary approaches may decrease the reliance on antihyperglycemic medications, particularly in patients diagnosed with type 2 diabetes.
